input.title: Public Healthcare Clusters Scale AI Deployment to Over 60 Clinical Tools
input.contentText: SINGAPORE, 18 March 2026 — Singapore's three public healthcare clusters have scaled their AI deployment to more than 60 tools in production, the Ministry of Health said. The AimSG radiology platform now screens over 400,000 chest X-rays a year across polyclinics, while AI-assisted triage in emergency departments has cut median waiting times by 18 per cent. Selene, an administrative AI assistant, drafts discharge summaries for 12,000 patients a month. MOH said adoption will expand to community hospitals next year, with S$120 million budgeted for health AI procurement and integration, and clinician training delivered through the AI in Healthcare Academy.
